description: This file defines the 'Project' class in a SuiteCRM module, extending SugarBean. It manages project entities including attributes, relationships, and methods for filling data, saving, and generating queries. It also includes custom logic for duplicating templates, handling related tasks, and resource relationships.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a Project entity in SuiteCRM, handling attributes, relationships, and business logic related to projects, including creation from templates, effort calculations, and related task management.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates related user name fields for display.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list view fields like assigned user's name.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Overrides parent method to update module relationships, e.g., contacts and users.

methods.name: _get_total_estimated_effort
methods.description: Calculates total estimated effort from related project tasks.

methods.name: _get_total_actual_effort
methods.description: Calculates total actual effort from related project tasks.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the project name for summaries.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a SQL WHERE clause for search queries.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view display, including assigned user info.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the bean implements specific interfaces such as ACL.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates a SQL query string for exporting project data, including related user info.

methods.name: getAllProjectTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all non-deleted tasks related to the project.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status value for new projects, based on field definitions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the project, including copying resource relationships, processing templates, and cascading task creation based on templates.
